icp.buyer: Platform, DevEx, DevSecOps, or AI-enablement owner responsible for safe coding-agent use across repos.
icp.daily_user: Developer or reviewer using multiple coding agents on merge-facing repository work.

packaging.mvp: Local CLI sidecar, first-party harness commands, fixture/demo pack, CI/script-friendly output, product-evidence export, install and cleanup docs, and limited platform-team support.
packaging.final_state: Enterprise platform package may add policy-as-code, evidence management, procurement artifacts, and support tiers after local substrate proof.

pricing.hypothesis: Unquoted design-partner or internal-platform pilot tied to repo, team, and caller evidence value; not token resale, model access, chat seats, or generic developer-assistant usage.

support.boundary: Limited async support for installation blockers, reproducible activation failures, docs gaps, privacy-safe export issues, and sidecar integration questions.

local_evidence_export.status: Required local metadata-only artifact with IDs, hashes, counts, blockers, classifications, and release-gate links.
local_evidence_export.privacy_posture: Metadata-only local export; no raw prompt, raw file body, secret, credential, private path, customer identifier, or hosted telemetry requirement.
